title: FedSharp: Byzantine Robust Decentralized Federated Learning Under Noisy Channel
abstract: arXiv:2611.05546v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Decentralized federated learning (DFL) eliminates the central aggregation server but remains vulnerable to data heterogeneity, Byzantine attacks, and channel noise. We show that noise accumulates as models propagate across nodes, becoming increasingly significant as the learning rate decays. Moreover, accumulated noise enables Byzantine attackers to exploit loss-based model selection by mimicking honest model averages. To address these challenges, we propose screened, hop-aware, ranked, proximal averaging, a robust DFL framework (FedSharp). In this approach, each node maintains models from its 2b predecessors, ensuring at least b honest candidates when at most b nodes are Byzantine. translated_title: FedSharp：噪声信道下的拜占庭鲁棒去中心化联邦学习
translated_abstract: 去中心化联邦学习（DFL）消除了中央聚合服务器，但仍然容易受到数据异构性、拜占庭攻击和信道噪声的影响。我们证明，随着模型在节点间传播，噪声会不断累积，并且随着学习率的衰减，这种累积噪声的影响变得越来越显著。此外，累积噪声使拜占庭攻击者能够通过模仿诚实模型的平均值来利用基于损失的模型选择机制。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了FedSharp——一种鲁棒的去中心化联邦学习框架，即筛选式、跳数感知、排序、近端平均方法。在该方法中，每个节点维护来自其2b个前驱节点的模型，从而在至多b个节点为拜占庭节点的情况下，确保至少有b个诚实的候选模型。FedSharp使用坐标式中值偏差来筛选可疑模型，对损失最低的b个候选模型进行平均，从而将新鲜信道噪声的方差降低b倍，并应用噪声自适应梯度范数正则化和近端训练来缓解……
tldr: 提出FedSharp框架，通过维护2b个前驱节点模型、坐标式中值偏差筛选可疑模型并对损失最低的b个候选模型取平均，在噪声信道下有效抵抗拜占庭攻击与信道噪声累积，实现鲁棒的去中心化联邦学习。
en_tdlr: FedSharp is a robust decentralized federated learning framework that defends against Byzantine attacks and accumulated channel noise by maintaining 2b predecessor models, screening suspicious ones via coordinate-wise median deviations, and averaging the b lowest-loss candidates.
